CustomField.description: Controls availability on new GiftTransactionDesignation splits via the GiftDesignationId lookup filter. An active GD cannot be deleted — the platform raises "You can't delete an active designation." Teardown pattern is un-default (IsDefault=false) → deactivate (IsActive=false) → delete. Deactivation does NOT affect existing historical GTD rows.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Uncheck to retire this designation. Retired designations stay on historical gifts but won't appear when adding new gifts.
